svg.title: Recording and the video editor
svg.desc: Record mode is picked on the Capture & record… toolbar, a window is chosen with the webcam, clicks and keys on, and a countdown starts the recording. Clicks show as rings and a shortcut as a key label. In the video editor the start is trimmed, a zoom is added and set to follow the cursor, playback zooms in on each click, and Export saves a new MP4.
